newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnair to code-share with Estonian Air.
newsitem.headline: Finnair to code-share with Estonian Air.

text.p: Finnish national carrier Finnair Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it had agreed with Estonian company Estonian Air on code share cooperation on flights between Helsinki and Tallinn.
The agreement will take effect on October 27, it said.
"The companies aim to develop transit traffic through both hubs by flexible schedules," Finnair said.
The agreement also covers services at the airports so Finnair will handle check-in of Estonian Air's passengers in Helsinki, and Estonian Air will handle Finnair passengers in Tallinn, it said.
Maersk Air A/S holds 49 percent of Estonian Air, the Estonian state holds 34 percent and Baltic Cresco Investment Group AS holds 17 percent, Finnair said.
